**Core issue:** The struct is fundamentally incompatible with the Holzman contract. Replace `status: String`, `is_validated: bool`, `is_sent: bool` with a single typestate enum (e.g., `enum ShardStage { New, Validated, Sent { sent_at_epoch_ms: u64 } }`), make all fields private, and use typestate-based method signatures to enforce valid transitions at compile time.
